title: Comparing Intrinsic Gender Bias Evaluation Measures without using Human Annotated Examples

bias_targets.methodology: Creating bias-controlled pre-trained language models (PLMs) by fine-tuning them on varying ratios of male and female gendered sentences mined from unannotated corpora, and then computing the rank correlation between the known fine-tuning gender proportions and the bias scores produced by various intrinsic evaluation measures (e.g., TBS, SSS, CPS, AUL, AULA).
